newsitem.title: USA: Florida fire kills four children.
newsitem.headline: Florida fire kills four children.

text.p: Four children were killed early on Tuesday when fire destroyed a house in inner-city Tampa that had burglar bars installed on its windows, the Tampa Fire Department said.
The fire, which began at about 2 a.m. EST, was blazing by the time about 35 firefighters arrived at the single-story frame home in Tampa's Ybor City district, Tampa Fire Capt. Bill Wade said.
"The burglar bars made entry difficult, but we were able to get in through the front door," Wade said. "Unfortunately, we were too late to save the kids."
He said the firefighters, told there were children inside the burning house, fought to keep sparks from setting fire to an adjacent house and a threatened propane tank.

Dead in the fire were Isaac Brown, 6; Kevin Brown, 9; Telena Allen, 12, and Mark Turner, 13. Two adults, Katie King, 68, and Katie Brown, 28, escaped, as did 4-year-old Ralph Brown, Wade said. He said he did not know the children's relationship to the adults.
Wade said the children's cause of death had not been determined. A routine investigation was under way to determine if the fire was the result of arson, he said.
